instruction: How can I cancel my order?
response:
Open the My Orders section of your account.
Select the order you want to cancel.
Check whether the Cancel Order option is available.
Select it and follow the instructions shown on the screen.
If cancellation is unavailable, contact customer support for help.

instruction: How can I track my order?
response:
Sign in to your account and open My Orders.
Choose the order you want to track.
Look for the tracking status or tracking link.
If a tracking number is provided, use it on the listed carrier's website.
If the status has not changed for a long time, contact customer support.

instruction: How do I request a refund?
response:
Open My Orders and select the relevant order.
Review the order details and look for a refund option.
If the option is available, select it and follow the instructions.
Keep your order number and payment details available for reference.
Contact customer support if you cannot submit the request or need clarification.

instruction: What should I do if my payment failed but money was deducted?
response:
First, check whether your order was confirmed in My Orders.
Review your bank statement or payment app for the transaction status.
Save the transaction reference, amount, and time of payment.
Avoid repeating the payment until you have checked the order status.
Contact customer support with these details if the deduction remains unresolved.

instruction: How do I reset my password?
response:
Open the sign-in page for your account.
Select the Forgot Password option.
Enter the email address or other account detail requested.
Follow the password-reset instructions sent to your registered contact method.
If you do not receive the message, check your spam folder and try again.

instruction: How can I contact a human support agent?
response:
Open the Contact Us or Help section of the website.
Review the support options available for your account.
Choose the available chat, phone, or email option.
Explain your issue clearly and provide your order number if relevant.
Do not share your password or one-time verification codes with anyone.

instruction: Can I change my delivery address?
response:
Open My Orders and select the order you want to update.
Check the order details for an address-editing option.
If the option is available, enter the correct address and save the change.
Address changes may be unavailable after an order has been processed or shipped.
If you cannot edit it, contact customer support as soon as possible.

instruction: How do I return a product?
response:
Open My Orders and select the product you want to return.
Review the return information and eligibility shown for that order.
If a return option is available, select it and follow the instructions.
Keep the product, accessories, and packaging until you review the return steps.
Contact customer support if the return option is missing or unclear.

instruction: My order arrived damaged. What should I do?
response:
Keep the damaged product and its packaging until you receive instructions.
Take clear photos of the damage and the package if possible.
Open My Orders and find the affected order.
Use the available return or support option to report the problem.
Include your order number and a short description when contacting support.

instruction: I received the wrong item. How can I fix this?
response:
Check the item received against the details in your order confirmation.
Keep the packaging and any labels until the issue is resolved.
Take a photo of the item if it helps explain the mismatch.
Open My Orders and report the issue through the available support option.
Provide your order number and ask about the available replacement or return steps.

instruction: How can I update my email address?
response:
Sign in to your account and open Account Settings.
Look for the profile or contact-information section.
If editing is available, enter your new email address and save the change.
Complete any verification step sent to your email if requested.
Contact customer support if you cannot access the old address or update the account.

instruction: How can I check whether my order was confirmed?
response:
Open My Orders and look for the order you recently placed.
Check whether an order number and order details are displayed.
Review your registered email for an order confirmation message.
If no confirmation appears, check your payment status before placing another order.
Contact customer support with the transaction details if you are unsure.

instruction: I forgot my account email. What can I do?
response:
Check previous order confirmations or account messages for the registered email.
If you use more than one email address, try the one used at checkout.
Use the account-recovery option if the website provides one.
Do not share passwords or verification codes while seeking help.
Contact customer support and follow its identity-verification process if needed.

instruction: How do I apply a discount code?
response:
Review the terms and conditions of the discount code first.
Add the eligible items to your cart and continue to checkout.
Enter the code in the coupon or discount field.
Apply the code and confirm that the order total changes before paying.
If the code is rejected, check its expiry, eligibility, and spelling.

instruction: The discount code is not working. Why?
response:
Check that the code has been entered exactly as provided.
Review its expiry date and any minimum-purchase requirement.
Confirm that the items in your cart qualify for the offer.
Check whether the code can be combined with other discounts.
If it still fails, contact customer support and share the error message without sharing sensitive payment data.

instruction: How can I download an invoice?
response:
Sign in and open My Orders.
Select the order for which you need an invoice.
Look for an Invoice, Receipt, or Download Document option.
Open or save the document for your records.
If no invoice option appears, contact customer support with the order number.

instruction: What should I do if my delivery is late?
response:
Open My Orders and review the latest delivery status.
Check any estimated delivery date or carrier tracking information shown.
Look for delivery updates in your registered email or messages.
If the estimate has passed or tracking has stopped updating, contact customer support.
Share your order number and the latest tracking status when asking for help.

instruction: Can I change the size or colour after ordering?
response:
Open My Orders and select the order you want to change.
Check whether editing or modification options are available.
If available, review the size or colour choices and save the change.
Some orders cannot be modified after processing or dispatch.
If editing is unavailable, contact customer support to ask about possible alternatives.

instruction: How do I delete my account?
response:
Sign in and open Account Settings or the Privacy section.
Look for an account deletion or account closure option.
Review the information about what may happen to your account data and order history.
Follow the displayed confirmation steps if you decide to proceed.
If the option is unavailable, contact customer support for the official process.

instruction: I cannot sign in to my account. What should I do?
response:
Check that your email address and password are entered correctly.
Make sure Caps Lock is not causing a typing issue.
Use Forgot Password if you are unsure of your password.
If the page shows an error, note the message and try again after checking your connection.
Contact customer support if you still cannot access your account.

instruction: How can I cancel a return request?
response:
Open My Orders and select the item with the return request.
Review the return status and check whether cancellation is available.
If a cancel option appears, select it and follow the confirmation steps.
If the return is already being processed, the option may not be available.
Contact customer support to ask what can be done for your specific request.

instruction: What should I do if I was charged twice?
response:
Review your bank statement or payment app for both transactions.
Check whether both charges correspond to separate confirmed orders.
Save the dates, amounts, and transaction references for both entries.
Avoid sharing full card numbers, passwords, or one-time codes.
Contact customer support and your payment provider if the duplicate charge remains unresolved.
